actual.cited_text: The Debtor may claim property exemptions under Illinois statutes.

Siti Rahman (hereinafter the Debtor) filed for bankruptcy on 12 August 2024. Siti Rahman owns a concert-grade oboe (French key system) worth $2,415.00. The Debtor may claim property exemptions under Illinois statutes.
